Spray chambers. Suction chamber. Over-sprayed coating material re-cycling system. Fumes exhaust system. Water spraying chamber to remove traces of coating material
Tanks Coating material tank. Solvent tank. Water tank.
Airless pump Double filter system : Two high pressure cassette

Airless pump Double filter system : Two high pressure cassette filters provided in series with drain ball valves. In-line heater. Two auto on/off valve one for paint and one for solvent. Spray Ring for different type of pipe sizes
Spray Chamber: The tube moving on the conveyor enters in a cube

Spray Chamber: The tube moving on the conveyor enters in a cube shaped spray chamber through a round opening at the end wall of the spray chamber. Suction Chamber: Inside the chamber, it passes through a circular spraying ring mounted with a number of airless spray Nozzles. These spray nozzles are mounted on adjustable rods to adjust spraying distance from the tube outer surface. The spray nozzle size, the spraying distance and the number of nozzles depends on i) tube size (OD), ii) Conveyor speed, iii) required coating thickness, iv) coating material specifications (viscosity etc.). Over Spray Re-cycling System: Over-sprayed coating material is collected at the bottom of the spray chamber. A Hippo pump is used to re-circulate this material to the coating material tank through a bag type low-pressure filter. Fumes Collection: The fumes created by spray (Hot airless spray creates minimum fumes compared to any other type of spray systems) are sucked and blown out with the help of exhaust blower provided at the top of the spray chamber. Some traces of the coating material are carried by these exhaust fumes, these fumes are first collected in suction chamber on both sides then these fumes enter in water spray chamber.  Water Spraying Chamber to Remove Traces of Coating Material: In water spray chamber water is sprayed from top and collected in water collection chamber. When the fumes pass through water spray chamber the traces of coating material mix with water droplets and the mixture is collected in the water collection chamber. The fumes get dissolved in water and get sucked through Moisture separating baffles by the blower. The moisture along with fumes gets settled on the moisture separating baffles and clean air is passed out by a centrifugal Blower to high altitudes in atmosphere through Air Ducts.  A part of fumes which gets dissolved in water and passes back to 500ltr water tank.  The water gets filtered here in the Tank which has different The water gets filtered here in the Tank which has different filter chambers. Again the fumes are settled on filtration panels. Clean water gets collected in the last chamber from where it is again re-circulated to water spray chambers

Step -1 Fume Collected from Paint Booth (with the help of blower suction) and passes towards the Water Shower Chamber. Step -3 Remaining particle traps in metal filter. After which very less polluted air passes towards blower inlet. Step -4 Blower sucks the air from metal filter and passes it through ducts to water collection tank. Step -5 This less polluted air gets forcefully dissolved in water collection tank. In this process very fine particle also dissolve in water
